The '''Ryll Warehouse''' was a bunker located on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was used by [[Vuul Sarlin]] and his group to stock the [[Ryll/Legends|Ryll spice]] distributed in [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]].

==History==
{{Quote|Stay away from that warehouse. It doesn't concern you.|Jaylon Geissler, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CCFRSR" />}}
The Ryll Warehouse was located on the outskirts of the Corellian city of Kor Vella. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the building belonged to a group of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealers led by Vuul Sarlin and was used to stock [[Ryll/Legends|Ryll]] prior to its sale in Kor Vella. The spice was provided by the [[Chirq Council]], best known as the Red Circle Gang, but Vuul Sarlin and his men ignored everything about the identity of the ryll smugglers. The warehouse was managed by [[Jaylon Geissler]], the right-hand of Vuul Sarlin.<ref name="SWG:CCFRSR" />
[[File:Ryll_Warehouse_guards.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Sarlin's guards in the warehouse.]]

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the ryll smuggling ring following the increase of spice traffic in Kor Vella. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lon Cope|Cope]] questioned a local spice addict known as [[Menchi Lerann]]. The man revealed that he bought his ryll from Vuul Sarlin and Jaylon Geissler. The spacer later interrogated Geissler but the spice dealer obviously refused to collaborate. The spacer therefore entered the ryll warehouse, fought the guards and started to destroy crates of spice. Jaylon Geissler reluctantly accepted to give Vuul Sarlin's current location. The spacer then defeated Vuul Sarlin and forced him to reveal everything he knew about the ryll smuggling ring.<ref name="SWG:CCFRSR" /> The CorSec investigation eventually led to the disbandment of the Chirq Council.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ryll Warehouse appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CCFRSR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Ryll Warehouse was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
